Project.NAME: marktext-modernized
Project.keywords: markdown, editor, wysiwyg, electron, tauri, vue3, muya, macos, homebrew, port, modernization
Project.annotation: Phase-A (Electron 30 + Vue 3) and Phase-B (Tauri v2 + Rust) module graph. Phase-A retains upstream structure (src/main, src/renderer, src/muya, src/common) and is represented only by muya (M-012) and renderer (M-011) here. Phase-B introduces Rust backend modules M-001..M-010 plus the IPC bridge M-013.

M-001.NAME: mt-tauri-shell
M-001.purpose: Tauri app entrypoint; builds app, registers plugins, manages windows and lifecycle. Phase-B1 delivered 5 sub-modules covering boot-time guards, validation, security audit, panic recovery, lifecycle primitives, and the PDF-export contract surface.

sub-module.name: m001_validate
sub-module.purpose: BLOCK_VALIDATE_AGAINST_FIXTURE on-boot parity check (embedded tauri.v2.json vs REGISTERED_COMMANDS); native dialog + exit(1) on drift

sub-module.name: m001_security
sub-module.purpose: WebView shell security posture audit (CSP, freezePrototype:FALSE [inverted 2026-04-29 — Element Plus + Vue ecosystem requires writable Object.prototype; defense moves to CSP+DOMPurify], assetProtocol disabled, dangerousDisableAssetCspModification false); native dialog + exit(1) on regression

sub-module.name: m001_panic
sub-module.purpose: std::panic::set_hook installer + crash-log writer to cache_root/crash-{ts}-{chain}.log; re-entrancy-safe; never panics in handler

sub-module.name: m001_pdf
sub-module.purpose: mt::print_to_pdf MT_UNSUPPORTED stub; PDF export delegated to M-015 mt-pandoc-bridge per phase-b1-pdf-export-strategy.md

sub-module.name: m001_lifecycle
sub-module.purpose: CloseStateMachine (8 states), MenuGeneration AtomicU64, ReplayPolicy enum; types only at B1, runtime hooks deferred to B2/B3 (F-LIFECYCLE-WIRE, F-MENU-GEN-WIRE, F-REPLAY-POLICY-WIRE)

sub-module.name: m_v1_compat
sub-module.purpose: Tauri-side stubs for v1.2.3 IPC channels not yet ported to dedicated modules. After Path B-clean M-3 (commit 014218fb 2026-05-09) + sidebar-walk-fix (2026-05-20) holds 15 shims: mt_app_quit, mt_close_project_root, mt_cmd_open_file, mt_cmd_open_folder, mt_format_link_click, mt_open_file, mt_open_setting_window, mt_pick_folder, mt_request_keybindings, mt_request_window_content_size, mt_set_user_data, mt_set_user_preference, mt_update_sidebar_menu, mt_view_layout_changed, mt_walk_project. mt_walk_project extracted from mt_pick_folder to decouple folder-pick from walk — frontend calls walk AFTER ADD_PROJECT creates the tree root, fixing DROPPED_NO_ROOT race.

sub-module.name: m005_migrate
sub-module.purpose: F-PREFS-MIGRATE-V1 9-step migration pipeline: snapshot reader → preferences/dataCenter/keybindings/recent_docs migrators → keychain rename → orchestrator runner with lockfile + 16 MiB size guard → main.rs gate replacement → e2e fixture harness. 286/286 tests; replaces the MT_PREFS_V1_RUNNING stub abort.

sub-module.name: m001_save_close
sub-module.purpose: Save/close IPC bridge: mt_response_file_save, mt_response_file_save_as, mt_save_and_close_tabs, mt_close_window, mt_close_window_confirm. wire_close_handler registers WindowEvent::CloseRequested handler that prevents default close and emits mt::ask-for-close. SavedTabState return type for canonical save flow.

sub-module.name: m021_default_handler
sub-module.purpose: macOS .md default-handler registration: mt_set_default_md_handler, mt_get_default_md_handler, mt_unset_default_md_handler. Uses LSSetDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType via Objective-C bridge.

fn-main.PURPOSE: Boot order: panic_hook → legacy detect → MARK_SKIP_MIGRATION env check → migration dialog (if needed) → security audit → fixture validate → tauri::Builder with M-013-B + m001_pdf invoke handlers

fn-mt_print_to_pdf.PURPOSE: MT_UNSUPPORTED stub; lives at m001_pdf::mt_print_to_pdf — registered in main.rs generate_handler! alongside M-013-B commands

fn-mt_dev_diag.PURPOSE: main.rs::mt_dev_diag — dev-only renderer error sink. WebviewWindow::eval injects window.onerror + unhandledrejection + console.error hooks (gated by cfg!(debug_assertions)) that pipe payloads here for backend stderr. Production no-op (command compiled in but never invoked). Added Phase 8 to diagnose F-DEV-MODE-WHITE-SCREEN; kept as permanent dev aid.

fn-install_panic_hook.PURPOSE: m001_panic runtime entry; emits BLOCK_PANIC_HOOK_INSTALLED + (on panic) BLOCK_PANIC_HOOK_FIRED

type-CloseStateMachine.PURPOSE: Window-close lifecycle enforcement; 8 states + transition validator + 8 BLOCK_* markers per state

type-MenuGeneration.PURPOSE: AtomicU64 counter; bump_menu_generation/check_stale; emits BLOCK_MENU_GENERATION_BUMPED + BLOCK_STALE_MENU_GENERATION

type-IpcError.PURPOSE: m001_pdf-side UnsupportedError envelope; distinct from M-013-B's MT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED — code MT_UNSUPPORTED

fn-exit_requested_handler.PURPOSE: RunEvent::ExitRequested interceptor in main.rs run callback. Prevents immediate exit, emits mt::ask-for-close to trigger dirty-tab dialog. Checks PendingOpens.quit_approved flag to allow confirmed exits through. Handles no-window case by force-exiting.

fn-mt_format_link_click.PURPOSE: m_v1_compat command: extracts href from data payload, resolves relative paths against dirname, opens URL/file via macOS open command. Handles mt::format-link-click IPC from linkTools jump action.

fn-mt_walk_project.PURPOSE: m_v1_compat command: extracted from mt_pick_folder. Accepts a directory path, runs WalkBuilder walk, and emits mt::update-object-tree events. Called by frontend AFTER ADD_PROJECT creates tree root, fixing race where walk events arrived before root existed (DROPPED_NO_ROOT). Registered in main.rs invoke_handler.

fn-isDirty-treeFile.PURPOSE: treeFile.vue computed: cross-refs file pathname against editor tabs via isSamePathSync (with optional chaining for fileUtils safety). Returns true when matching tab exists and is unsaved. Drives amber text + dot CSS styling for dirty files in folder tree.

fn-isDirty-treeOpenedTab.PURPOSE: treeOpenedTab.vue: unsaved indicator changed from green (--highlightThemeColor) to amber (--warningColor, #d97706). Amber text applied to unsaved filenames for consistency with treeFile dirty styling.

fn-ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT-walk-guard.PURPOSE: project.js: ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT calls mt_walk_project AFTER ADD_PROJECT, guarded by projectTrees length check to skip walk when ADD_PROJECT rejects (dedup/nested). Ensures walk events are never emitted before root exists.

M-010.NAME: mt-security
M-010.purpose: Backend security primitives: path sandbox (lexical + canonical, rejects traversal/symlink-escape/NUL/overlong), URL scheme allowlist (http/https/file: only; rejects javascript:, data:, vbscript:, mt://, tab/CRLF-smuggled variants), shell-open executable-extension blocklist. Renderer-side concerns (HTML sanitizer / KaTeX / Vega / punycode warning / shell.open user-confirm prompt) deferred to Phase-B3.

fn-check_path.PURPOSE: Reject NUL/overlong/traversal/symlink-escape; canonicalize when both paths exist; emit BLOCK_NUL_OR_OVERLONG / BLOCK_REJECT_TRAVERSAL / BLOCK_SYMLINK_ESCAPES

fn-check_url_scheme.PURPOSE: Allowlist http/https/file; strip control chars + whitespace before scheme parse to defeat tab/CRLF smuggling; emit BLOCK_SCHEME scheme=<name>

fn-check_shell_open_extension.PURPOSE: Block .command/.app/.scpt/.scptd/.lnk/.url/.desktop/.applescript regardless of sandbox; emit BLOCK_EXECUTABLE_EXT ext=<name>

fn-lexical_normalize.PURPOSE: Internal: fold . and .. against parent components without touching FS; returns None on root-escape

fn-extract_scheme.PURPOSE: Internal: pull scheme from URL string, control-char-stripped + lowercased

type-SecurityError.PURPOSE: 7-variant enum: NulByteInPath, OverlongPath, PathTraversal, SymlinkEscapesSandbox, DisallowedUrlScheme, DangerousShellOpenExtension, IoError. Display + Error impls.

const-MAX_PATH_BYTES.PURPOSE: POSIX PATH_MAX=4096 ceiling; rejected before any syscall

const-DANGEROUS_SHELL_OPEN_EXTENSIONS.PURPOSE: 8 entries covering macOS+Linux+cross-platform; Windows .bat/.cmd/.ps1/.vbs added when Windows port lands
